PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: Drive rovers and ships with rotors, pistons or hinges without waiting for the server.
PluginData.Description: Sir Correctifs Pulsar turns on, on your machine only, two predictions Space Engineers already has but keeps off. Wheeled vehicle prediction: the rover you drive and each of its wheels are simulated on your machine, so it answers your keys at once. Mechanical blocks prediction: a ship that carries a rotor, a piston or a hinge is simulated on your machine when you pilot it, its attached parts with it. Each setting is turned on or off separately in the plugin settings; both are on by default. Nothing is sent to the server and nothing changes on it: players without the plugin play as usual. The game's own safeguards stay in place: when the server's corrections pile up, the game goes back to server driven movement by itself.
